title: Make Stream 0 honor configured TCP permanently
description: Remove the Stream 0-only nvurisrcbin transport override that rewrites configured tcp to auto/multi, delete the temporary HICON_STREAM_0_NVURISRCBIN_RESPECT_CONFIGURED_PROTOCOL plumbing, keep outage instrumentation and soak tooling, and validate Stream 0 starts with requested=tcp effective=tcp plus a post-change soak.

title: Implement Stream 0 RTSP proof soak instrumentation
description: Add temporary runtime observability and soak tooling to prove whether Stream 0's recurring ~300s no-data/reconnect event is dominated by nvurisrcbin transport behavior, Jetson receive-buffer limits, or camera/path 192.168.28.119. Scope includes structured per-stream outage/recovery logs, an explicit Stream 0 nvurisrcbin transport override toggle, and a repeatable soak capture helper that collects journal evidence, tegrastats, NIC counters, and socket buffer state for baseline, forced-TCP, and forced-TCP-plus-buffer runs.

title: fix: nvurisrcbin FPS watchdog restart corrupts vsrc_0 pad, stalling stream 0 permanently
description: The 90s FPS watchdog calls schedule_stream_restart() on nvurisrcbin (stream 0). Cycling nvurisrcbin through NULL does not clean its dynamic vsrc_0 pad, so when it returns to PLAYING GStreamer emits 'Padname vsrc_0 is not unique'. After that, no video pad can be added and stream 0 is permanently stuck at 0fps despite nvurisrcbin's own reconnect still running. Fix: skip the NULL→PLAYING state cycle for nvurisrcbin streams; let built-in reconnect handle drops. Escalate to full service restart (loop.quit) only after 300s.
close_reason: Fixed in commit 3028c2b: track nvurisrcbin streams in gst_builder, skip destructive state-cycle restart for them, escalate to service restart after 300s instead

value: Stream 0 analysis probe (HICON_STREAM_0_ANALYSIS_PROBE_ENABLED): setting to true causes segfault — the Python analysis probe calls pyds.get_nvds_buf_surface() on the NV12 analysis branch buffer while the main path (nvosd/nvinfer) is still accessing the same shared NVMM buffer on a different thread → IOMMU conflict on Jetson (same issue C++ plugin explicitly avoids). Leave false. Pouring runs via main-path CPU analysis fallback (osd_sink_pad_probe_stream0, update_main_path=True). Root cause of original gap: interval=1 (commit 7cc442b, 2026-05-01) halved detection rate from 25fps to 12.5fps, making brief ladle-mouth detection windows (~5s) miss the 25-frame accumulation threshold. Fix: interval=0 restored in config_pouring_pgie.txt.

Stream 0 RTSP drops root cause (confirmed 2026-05-04): gst_builder.py was silently overriding tcp→auto (UDP multi) for nvurisrcbin on stream 0, despite HICON_RTSP_PROTOCOL_0=tcp. UDP has no retransmission so any backpressure/packet loss killed the session. Fix: HICON_STREAM_0_NVURISRCBIN_RESPECT_CONFIGURED_PROTOCOL=true in .env. Confirmed by 3-soak proof (baseline=drops, force-tcp=0 outages in 330s). All the camera-side theories (300s firmware timer, bitrate, audio, CH102 switch) were red herrings — the bug was in our own code.
